erikvukk: Konrad Erikvukk came from Oakmere, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.
Konrad Erikvukk answered the first call, number 37 on the rolls. Somebody chalked the number on his helmet. It has not washed off yet.
The new duty roster listed Konrad Erikvukk as a stretcher bearer. He kept checking the old roster until someone took it down.
Verdel Ridge has been won. Konrad Erikvukk listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Konrad Erikvukk splinted a broken leg with a rifle and two belts. The patient asked if he was a real doctor. He said yes. He was lying.
mrpickypants_: The new machine gunner gave his name as Edmund "Parson" Mrpickypants. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
Edmund "Parson" Mrpickypants received the First Wave ribbon. He checked the stitching twice before putting the tunic back on.
Edmund "Parson" Mrpickypants walked the captured trenches of Verdel Ridge and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Edmund "Parson" Mrpickypants was halfway through a story when his listener fell asleep. He counted that as a success.
